page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 8 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of 1 thread per core. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a dedicated CPU allocation and a low memory-to-core ratio, the instance is structured for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated core model ensures consistent CPU performance without resource sharing. Suitable workloads include parallel processing, batch computing, and lightweight compute-intensive applications.
